label: A total holder of a lackable act gives being, from the esse-side support of C*-holding
description: New non-transcription conditional derivation. Let z totally hold x in r, with x in act in r and able to lack that act. By the lackable-being bridge x is in act as to being and could lack being; by the esse instance some g other than x presently actualizes x as to being; by accident-inclusive conservation g presently actualizes x in r; since z is the only holder of x in r, g is z. So on the bundle that supports C* in the holding sense (section 9.1), every total holder of a lackable act is a holding-sense giver of being (the holding relation at esse). Identifying it with a giver of being in the timed sense used by the esse-root routes (BeingGiving.GivesAt) would need the converse of clause (c) of the present-moment reading dedc431f, which is not formulated; and the total-holding regress c4e333da remains a separate premise. All premises stay OPEN. No premise is established.
